en: In the very beginning there was nothing at all — only God. Then God spoke, and light shone out of the darkness! He called the light “day” and the darkness “night.”
Day after day God kept creating. He made the sky and the seas, the land and the trees, the sun, the moon and the twinkling stars. He filled the water with fish and the sky with birds.
Then God made animals of every kind — big elephants, tall giraffes and tiny ants. Last of all, God made people, a man and a woman, to be His friends and to take care of His world.
God looked at everything He had made, and it was very good! On the seventh day God rested.
am: በመጀመሪያ ምንም ነገር አልነበረም — እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ነበረ። እግዚአብሔርም «ብርሃን ይሁን» አለ፤ ብርሃንም ከጨለማ ውስጥ በራ! ብርሃኑን «ቀን» ጨለማውንም «ሌሊት» ብሎ ጠራው።
እግዚአብሔር ቀን በቀን መፍጠሩን ቀጠለ። ሰማይንና ባሕርን፣ ምድርንና ዛፎችን፣ ፀሐይን፣ ጨረቃንና የሚያበሩ ከዋክብትን ሠራ። ውኃውን በዓሣ፣ ሰማዩንም በወፎች ሞላ።
ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር ልዩ ልዩ እንስሳትን ፈጠረ — ትልልቅ ዝሆኖችን፣ ረጃጅም ቀጭኔዎችንና ትንንሽ ጉንዳኖችን። በመጨረሻም ወዳጆቹ እንዲሆኑና ዓለሙን እንዲጠብቁ ወንድና ሴት ሰዎችን ፈጠረ።
እግዚአብሔር የሠራውን ሁሉ አየ፤ እነሆም እጅግ መልካም ነበረ! በሰባተኛውም ቀን አረፈ።
lesson_en: God made everything, and He made you too. You are special to Him!
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ፈጠረ፤ አንተንም ፈጠረህ። ለእርሱ ልዩ ነህ!

quiz.q_en: What did God make first?
On which day did God rest?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, for making the beautiful world and for making me. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ውብ የሆነውን ዓለምና እኔን ስለ ፈጠርከኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

title_en: Adam and Eve in the Garden
en: God put Adam and Eve in a beautiful garden called Eden. They could eat from every tree except one. “Do not eat from that tree,” God said, “or you will die.”
A sneaky snake came to Eve and said, “Did God really say that? You won’t die!” Eve looked at the fruit, ate some, and gave some to Adam too.
Right away they felt ashamed and hid from God. Because they disobeyed, they had to leave the garden. Sin had come into the world.
But God still loved them. He made clothes for them and promised that one day a Saviour would come to defeat the snake.
am: እግዚአብሔር አዳምንና ሔዋንን ኤደን በምትባል ውብ ገነት አኖራቸው። ከአንዲት ዛፍ በቀር ከሁሉም መብላት ይችሉ ነበር። እግዚአብሔርም «ከዚያች ዛፍ አትብሉ፤ ብትበሉ ትሞታላችሁ» አላቸው።
ተንኮለኛው እባብ ወደ ሔዋን መጥቶ «በእውነት እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሏልን? አትሞቱም!» አላት። ሔዋንም ፍሬውን አይታ በላች፤ ለአዳምም ሰጠችው።
ወዲያውኑ ዕፍረት ተሰማቸውና ከእግዚአብሔር ተደበቁ። ስላልታዘዙም ከገነት መውጣት ነበረባቸው። ኃጢአት ወደ ዓለም ገባ።
እግዚአብሔር ግን አሁንም ይወዳቸው ነበር። ልብስ አለበሳቸው፤ አንድ ቀን እባቡን የሚያሸንፍ አዳኝ እንደሚመጣም ተስፋ ሰጣቸው።
lesson_en: Obeying God is best. When we do wrong, we can say sorry and God forgives us.
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔርን መታዘዝ መልካም ነው። ስንሳሳት ይቅርታ ብንጠይቅ እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይለናል።

quiz.q_en: Who tricked Eve?
What did God promise?

prayer_en: Dear God, help me to obey You. Thank You for forgiving me. Amen.
prayer_am: ውድ አምላኬ፥ እንድታዘዝህ እርዳኝ። ይቅር ስለምትለኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: People everywhere had become very wicked, but Noah loved God. God told Noah, “Build a huge boat called an ark, because a great flood is coming.”
Noah obeyed, even when people laughed at him. When the ark was finished, God brought animals two by two — lions, sheep, zebras and doves — and Noah’s family went inside.
It rained for forty days and forty nights until water covered the whole earth. But everyone inside the ark was safe.
When the water dried up, Noah thanked God. God put a beautiful rainbow in the sky as a promise never to flood the whole earth again.
am: በየቦታው ሰዎች እጅግ ክፉዎች ሆነው ነበር፤ ኖኅ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ይወድ ነበር። እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን «ታላቅ የጥፋት ውኃ ስለሚመጣ መርከብ ሥራ» አለው።
ሰዎች ቢስቁበትም ኖኅ ታዘዘ። መርከቡ ሲያልቅ እግዚአብሔር እንስሳትን ሁለት ሁለት አድርጎ አመጣ — አንበሶችን፣ በጎችን፣ የሜዳ አህዮችንና ርግቦችን፤ የኖኅ ቤተሰብም ወደ ውስጥ ገቡ።
አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ዝናብ ዘነበ፤ ውኃውም ምድርን ሁሉ ሸፈነ። በመርከቡ ውስጥ የነበሩት ሁሉ ግን በሰላም ተጠበቁ።
ውኃው ሲደርቅ ኖኅ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ። እግዚአብሔርም ዳግመኛ ምድርን በውኃ እንደማያጠፋ የተስፋ ምልክት አድርጎ ቀስተ ደመናን በሰማይ አኖረ።
lesson_en: God keeps His promises and takes care of those who trust Him.
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ቃሉን ይጠብቃል፤ በእርሱ የሚታመኑትንም ይጠብቃቸዋል።

quiz.q_en: How long did it rain?
What was God’s promise sign?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, that You always keep Your promises. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ቃልህን ሁልጊዜ ስለምትጠብቅ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: God told Abram, “Leave your home and go to a land I will show you.” Abram trusted God and set out with his wife Sarai, even though he didn’t know where he was going.
Abram and Sarai were very old and had no children. One night God took Abram outside and said, “Look up at the sky. Can you count the stars? Your family will be like that!”
Abram believed God, and God was pleased with his faith. God changed his name to Abraham, which means “father of many.”
Years later, just as God promised, Sarah had a baby boy named Isaac. Their family grew and grew!
am: እግዚአብሔር አብራምን «ከአገርህ ውጣ፤ ወደማሳይህ ምድር ሂድ» አለው። አብራምም የሚሄድበትን ባያውቅም በእግዚአብሔር ታምኖ ከሚስቱ ከሦራ ጋር ተነሣ።
አብራምና ሦራ እጅግ ሸምግለው ነበር፤ ልጅም አልነበራቸውም። አንድ ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር አብራምን ወደ ውጭ አውጥቶ «ወደ ሰማይ ተመልከት፤ ከዋክብትን መቍጠር ትችላለህን? ዘርህ እንዲሁ ይሆናል!» አለው።
አብራምም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእምነቱ ደስ አለው። ስሙንም «የብዙዎች አባት» ማለት የሆነውን አብርሃም ብሎ ለወጠው።
ከዓመታት በኋላ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው ሣራ ይስሐቅ የሚባል ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች። ቤተሰባቸውም እጅግ በዛ!
lesson_en: We can trust God even when we can’t see how things will happen.
lesson_am: ነገሮች እንዴት እንደሚሆኑ ባናይም በእግዚአብሔር መታመን እንችላለን።

quiz.q_en: What did God ask Abraham to count?
What was the name of Abraham’s son?

prayer_en: God, help me trust You like Abraham did. Amen.
prayer_am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እንደ አብርሃም እንድታመንህ እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: Jacob loved his son Joseph very much and gave him a beautiful coat of many colours. Joseph’s older brothers became jealous and angry.
One day the brothers sold Joseph to traders going to Egypt. Joseph was far from home, and later he was even put in prison for something he didn’t do. But God was with Joseph.
God helped Joseph explain the king’s dreams. Pharaoh made Joseph a great ruler in Egypt, and Joseph saved food for a coming famine.
When his hungry brothers came to buy food, Joseph forgave them. “You meant it for evil,” he said, “but God meant it for good.”
am: ያዕቆብ ልጁን ዮሴፍን እጅግ ይወደው ነበር፤ ባለ ብዙ ኅብር ያማረ ልብስም አሠራለት። ታላላቅ ወንድሞቹም ቀኑበትና ተቈጡ።
አንድ ቀን ወንድሞቹ ዮሴፍን ወደ ግብፅ ለሚሄዱ ነጋዴዎች ሸጡት። ዮሴፍ ከቤቱ ርቆ ሄደ፤ ባልሠራው ጥፋትም ወደ ወኅኒ ገባ። እግዚአብሔር ግን ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ።
እግዚአብሔር ዮሴፍ የንጉሡን ሕልም እንዲፈታ ረዳው። ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን በግብፅ ላይ ታላቅ ገዥ አደረገው፤ ዮሴፍም ለሚመጣው ራብ እህል አከማቸ።
የተራቡ ወንድሞቹ እህል ሊገዙ ሲመጡ ዮሴፍ ይቅር አላቸው። «እናንተ ክፉ አሰባችሁብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለመልካም አሰበው» አላቸው።
lesson_en: God can turn bad things into good, and He wants us to forgive.
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ክፉውን ወደ መልካም ሊለውጥ ይችላል፤ ይቅር እንድንል ይፈልጋል።

quiz.q_en: What did Jacob give Joseph?
What did Joseph do when his brothers came?

prayer_en: Lord, help me forgive others the way Joseph did. Amen.
prayer_am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንደ ዮሴፍ ሌሎችን ይቅር እንድል እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: In Egypt, a cruel king ordered that all baby boys of God’s people be thrown into the river. One mother hid her baby boy for three months.
When she couldn’t hide him anymore, she made a little basket, covered it so water couldn’t get in, and placed her baby among the reeds of the Nile River. His sister Miriam watched nearby.
Pharaoh’s daughter came to the river, found the crying baby and felt sorry for him. Miriam bravely asked, “Shall I find a Hebrew woman to nurse him?” — and she brought his own mother!
The princess named the baby Moses. God protected him, because He had a big plan for Moses’ life.
am: በግብፅ ጨካኝ ንጉሥ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ወንዶች ሕፃናት ሁሉ ወደ ወንዝ እንዲጣሉ አዘዘ። አንዲት እናት ግን ወንድ ልጇን ሦስት ወር ደበቀችው።
ከዚያ በላይ ልትደብቀው ባልቻለች ጊዜ ትንሽ ቅርጫት ሠርታ ውኃ እንዳይገባ ለቀለቀችው፤ ሕፃኑንም በዓባይ ወንዝ ዳር በቄጠማ መካከል አኖረችው። እኅቱ ማርያምም በቅርብ ትጠብቅ ነበር።
የፈርዖን ልጅ ወደ ወንዙ መጥታ የሚያለቅሰውን ሕፃን አገኘችውና አዘነችለት። ማርያምም በድፍረት «የምታጠባው ዕብራዊት ሴት ልጥራልሽን?» አለቻት — የገዛ እናቱንም አመጣች!
ልዕልቲቱም ሕፃኑን ሙሴ ብላ ጠራችው። እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ ሕይወት ታላቅ እቅድ ስለ ነበረው ጠበቀው።
lesson_en: God watches over us and has a good plan for our lives.
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀናል፤ ለሕይወታችንም መልካም እቅድ አለው።

quiz.q_en: Where was baby Moses placed?
o_en: In a basket on the river

quiz.q_en: Who watched over the basket?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, for watching over me every day. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ በየቀኑ ስለምትጠብቀኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: God used Moses to lead His people out of slavery in Egypt. But soon Pharaoh changed his mind and chased them with horses and chariots.
The people were trapped between the sea and the army. They were very afraid! Moses said, “Don’t be afraid. The Lord will fight for you.”
Moses stretched out his hand, and God sent a strong wind that split the sea in two. The people walked across on dry ground with walls of water on each side!
When everyone was safe, the water came back. God’s people sang and danced, praising God for saving them.
am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ከግብፅ ባርነት እንዲያወጣ ሙሴን ተጠቀመበት። ፈርዖን ግን ብዙም ሳይቆይ ሐሳቡን ለውጦ በፈረሶችና በሰረገሎች አሳደዳቸው።
ሕዝቡ በባሕሩና በሠራዊቱ መካከል ተከበቡ። እጅግም ፈሩ! ሙሴ ግን «አትፍሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋል» አላቸው።
ሙሴ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ባሕሩን ለሁለት የሚከፍል ብርቱ ነፋስ ላከ። ሕዝቡም በቀኝና በግራ የውኃ ግድግዳ ሆኖላቸው በደረቅ መሬት ተሻገሩ!
ሁሉም በደኅና ሲሻገሩ ውኃው ተመለሰ። የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብም ስላዳናቸው እየዘመሩና እያሸበሸቡ አመሰገኑት።
lesson_en: When we are afraid, God is stronger than any problem.
lesson_am: ስንፈራ፣ እግዚአብሔር ከማንኛውም ችግር ይበልጣል።

quiz.q_en: What did God do to the sea?

prayer_en: God, when I am scared, remind me that You are with me. Amen.
prayer_am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስፈራ ከእኔ ጋር እንዳለህ አስታውሰኝ። አሜን።

en: After leaving Egypt, God’s people camped by Mount Sinai. The mountain shook, there was thunder and lightning, and God called Moses to the top.
There God gave Moses ten special rules written on two stone tablets. They teach us to love God first and to love other people.
“Have no other gods but Me. Honour your father and mother. Do not steal. Do not lie.” These rules show us how to live God’s good way.
God gave His rules because He loves His people and wants them to be happy and safe.
am: ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ በሲና ተራራ አጠገብ ሰፈሩ። ተራራው ተናወጠ፤ ነጐድጓድና መብረቅ ሆነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ጠራው።
በዚያም እግዚአብሔር በሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ የተጻፉ አሥር ልዩ ትእዛዛትን ለሙሴ ሰጠው። እነርሱም እግዚአብሔርን አስቀድመን እንድንወድና ሌሎችን እንድንወድ ያስተምሩናል።
«ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር። አትስረቅ። በሐሰት አትመስክር።» እነዚህ ትእዛዛት የእግዚአብሔርን መልካም መንገድ ያሳዩናል።
እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዛቱን የሰጠው ሕዝቡን ስለሚወድና ደስተኞችና ደኅና እንዲሆኑ ስለሚፈልግ ነው።
lesson_en: God’s rules are gifts that help us love Him and others.
lesson_am: የእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዛት እርሱንና ሌሎችን እንድንወድ የሚረዱን ስጦታዎች ናቸው።

quiz.q_en: On what were the commandments written?
How many commandments are there?

prayer_en: Lord, help me to love You and to love others. Amen.
prayer_am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተንና ሌሎችን እንድወድ እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: Joshua became the new leader of God’s people. In front of them was the city of Jericho with huge, strong walls.
God gave Joshua a strange plan: “March around the city once a day for six days. On the seventh day march around seven times, then blow the trumpets and shout!”
The people obeyed. On the seventh day, after the seventh time around, the priests blew their trumpets and everyone gave a great shout.
CRASH! The mighty walls fell down flat, and God gave them the city.
am: ኢያሱ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ አዲስ መሪ ሆነ። በፊታቸውም ታላላቅና ጽኑ ቅጥሮች ያሏት ኢያሪኮ ከተማ ነበረች።
እግዚአብሔር ለኢያሱ እንግዳ የሆነ እቅድ ሰጠው፦ «ለስድስት ቀን በቀን አንድ ጊዜ ከተማዋን ዙሩ። በሰባተኛው ቀን ሰባት ጊዜ ዙሩ፤ ከዚያም መለከት ንፉና ጩኹ!»
ሕዝቡም ታዘዙ። በሰባተኛው ቀን ለሰባተኛ ጊዜ ከዞሩ በኋላ ካህናቱ መለከት ነፉ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኹ።
ድው! ጽኑዎቹ ቅጥሮች ወደቁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከተማዋን ሰጣቸው።
lesson_en: When we obey God, even when it seems strange, He does great things.
lesson_am: እንግዳ ቢመስልም እግዚአብሔርን ስንታዘዝ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ያደርጋል።

quiz.q_en: How many times did they march on the seventh day?

prayer_en: God, help me obey You even when it is hard. Amen.
prayer_am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ቢከብድም እንድታዘዝህ እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: Samuel was a boy who helped the old priest Eli in God’s house. One night, as Samuel lay down to sleep, he heard someone call, “Samuel!”
He ran to Eli. “Here I am!” But Eli said, “I didn’t call you. Go back to bed.” This happened three times!
Eli realised it was God calling. He told Samuel, “If He calls again, say: ‘Speak, Lord, for Your servant is listening.’”
God called again, and Samuel answered just like that. Samuel grew up listening to God and became a great prophet.
am: ሳሙኤል በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሽማግሌውን ካህን ዔሊን የሚያገለግል ብላቴና ነበር። አንድ ሌሊት ሳሙኤል ሊተኛ ሲል «ሳሙኤል!» የሚል ድምፅ ሰማ።
ወደ ዔሊ ሮጦ «እነሆኝ!» አለ። ዔሊ ግን «አልጠራሁህም፤ ተመልሰህ ተኛ» አለው። ይህ ሦስት ጊዜ ሆነ!
ዔሊም የሚጠራው እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ አስተዋለ። ሳሙኤልንም «ደግሞ ቢጠራህ ‘ጌታ ሆይ፥ ባሪያህ ይሰማልና ተናገር’ በል» አለው።
እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገና ጠራው፤ ሳሙኤልም እንዲሁ መለሰ። ሳሙኤልም እግዚአብሔርን እየሰማ አደገ፤ ታላቅ ነቢይም ሆነ።
lesson_en: Even children can listen to God and serve Him.
lesson_am: ልጆችም እግዚአብሔርን መስማትና ማገልገል ይችላሉ።

quiz.q_en: Who was calling Samuel?

prayer_en: Speak, Lord, I am listening. Amen.
prayer_am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተናገር፤ እሰማለሁ። አሜን።

en: A giant named Goliath stood before Israel’s army every day shouting, “Send someone to fight me!” Everyone was too scared.
David, a young shepherd boy, said, “I will fight him! God helped me save my sheep from a lion and a bear, and He will help me now.”
David didn’t wear armour. He took his sling and five smooth stones from a stream. Goliath laughed at him, but David said, “I come in the name of the Lord!”
David swung his sling, and one stone hit Goliath on the forehead. The giant fell down! God gave the victory.
am: ጎልያድ የሚባል ግዙፍ ሰው በየቀኑ በእስራኤል ሠራዊት ፊት ቆሞ «የሚገጥመኝ ሰው ላኩ!» እያለ ይፎክር ነበር። ሁሉም እጅግ ፈሩ።
ዳዊት የተባለ ወጣት እረኛ ግን «እኔ እገጥመዋለሁ! እግዚአብሔር በጎቼን ከአንበሳና ከድብ እንዳድን ረድቶኛል፤ አሁንም ይረዳኛል» አለ።
ዳዊት የጦር ልብስ አልለበሰም። ወንጭፉንና ከወንዝ የለቀማቸውን አምስት ለስላሳ ድንጋዮች ያዘ። ጎልያድ ሣቀበት፤ ዳዊት ግን «እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እመጣብሃለሁ!» አለው።
ዳዊት ወንጭፉን አሽከረከረ፤ አንዲቱ ድንጋይ የጎልያድን ግንባር መታች። ግዙፉ ሰው ወደቀ! እግዚአብሔር ድልን ሰጠ።
lesson_en: With God, no problem is too big — even for a child.
lesson_am: ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ምንም ችግር አይበልጥብንም — ለልጅም ቢሆን።

quiz.q_en: How many stones did David pick up?
What was David’s job?

prayer_en: God, make me brave because You are with me. Amen.
prayer_am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ስላለህ ደፋር አድርገኝ። አሜን።

en: Daniel loved God and prayed to Him three times every day. Some jealous men tricked the king into making a law: “Anyone who prays to anyone except the king will be thrown to the lions!”
Daniel kept praying to God by his open window, just as he always did. The men caught him and told the king.
The king was sad, because he liked Daniel, but he had to keep his law. Daniel was thrown into a den of hungry lions, and a stone was put over the door.
Early the next morning the king ran to the den. “Daniel, did your God save you?” “Yes!” said Daniel. “God sent His angel to shut the lions’ mouths!”
am: ዳንኤል እግዚአብሔርን ይወድ ነበር፤ በየቀኑም ሦስት ጊዜ ይጸልይ ነበር። አንዳንድ ቀናተኞች ንጉሡን አታለው «ከንጉሡ በቀር ወደ ሌላ የሚጸልይ ሁሉ ለአንበሶች ይጣል» የሚል ሕግ አስወጡ።
ዳንኤል ግን እንደ ልማዱ በተከፈተ መስኮቱ ፊት ወደ እግዚአብሔር መጸለዩን ቀጠለ። ሰዎቹም ያዙትና ለንጉሡ ነገሩት።
ንጉሡ ዳንኤልን ይወደው ስለ ነበር አዘነ፤ ነገር ግን ሕጉን መጠበቅ ነበረበት። ዳንኤል በተራቡ አንበሶች ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ተጣለ፤ በደጁም ላይ ድንጋይ ተገጠመ።
በማግሥቱ ማልዶ ንጉሡ ወደ ጕድጓዱ ሮጠ። «ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አምላክህ አዳነህን?» አለው። ዳንኤልም «አዎን! እግዚአብሔር መልአኩን ልኮ የአንበሶቹን አፍ ዘጋ!» አለ።
lesson_en: Keep praying and trusting God, even when it is hard.
lesson_am: ቢከብድም መጸለይንና በእግዚአብሔር መታመንን አታቋርጥ።

quiz.q_en: How many times a day did Daniel pray?
quiz.q_am: ዳንኤል በቀን ስንት ጊዜ ይጸልይ ነበር?

quiz.q_en: Who shut the lions’ mouths?

prayer_en: Lord, help me talk to You every day. Amen.
prayer_am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ በየቀኑ ከአንተ ጋር እንድነጋገር እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: God told Jonah, “Go to the city of Nineveh and tell them to stop doing wrong.” But Jonah didn’t want to go, so he got on a ship going the other way!
God sent a huge storm. The sailors were terrified. Jonah said, “It’s my fault. Throw me into the sea.” When they did, the storm stopped.
God sent a giant fish to swallow Jonah. For three days and nights Jonah prayed inside the fish and said sorry to God. Then the fish spat him out onto dry land.
This time Jonah obeyed. The people of Nineveh listened, turned from their sin, and God forgave them. God loves all people!
am: እግዚአብሔር ዮናስን «ወደ ነነዌ ከተማ ሄደህ ክፋታቸውን እንዲተዉ ንገራቸው» አለው። ዮናስ ግን መሄድ ስላልፈለገ ወደ ተቃራኒ አቅጣጫ በሚሄድ መርከብ ተሳፈረ!
እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ማዕበል ላከ። መርከበኞቹ እጅግ ፈሩ። ዮናስም «ጥፋቱ የእኔ ነው፤ ወደ ባሕሩ ጣሉኝ» አለ። በጣሉትም ጊዜ ማዕበሉ ጸጥ አለ።
እግዚአብሔር ዮናስን የሚውጥ ታላቅ ዓሣ አዘጋጀ። ዮናስ በዓሣው ሆድ ውስጥ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ጸለየ፤ ይቅርታንም ለመነ። ዓሣውም ወደ የብስ ተፋው።
በዚህ ጊዜ ዮናስ ታዘዘ። የነነዌ ሰዎችም ሰሙ፤ ከኃጢአታቸው ተመለሱ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር ሰዎችን ሁሉ ይወዳል!
lesson_en: We can’t hide from God, and He gives second chances.
lesson_am: ከእግዚአብሔር መደበቅ አንችልም፤ እርሱም ሁለተኛ ዕድል ይሰጣል።

quiz.q_en: Where did Jonah pray for three days?
quiz.q_am: ዮናስ ሦስት ቀን የጸለየው የት ነው?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, for giving me another chance. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ሌላ ዕድል ስለ ሰጠኸኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: Esther was a young Jewish girl who became queen of Persia. A wicked man named Haman made a plan to destroy all the Jewish people.
Esther’s cousin Mordecai said, “Maybe God made you queen for such a time as this!” But going to the king without being called could mean death.
Esther asked everyone to fast and pray. Then she bravely went to the king. He held out his golden sceptre and welcomed her.
Esther told the king about Haman’s evil plan. The king stopped it, and God’s people were saved through Esther’s courage.
am: አስቴር የፋርስ ንግሥት የሆነች ወጣት አይሁዳዊት ነበረች። ሐማ የሚባል ክፉ ሰው አይሁድን ሁሉ ለማጥፋት አሰበ።
የአጎቷ ልጅ መርዶክዮስ «ምናልባት ለእንደዚህ ያለ ጊዜ ንግሥት የሆንሽው ይሆናል!» አላት። ሳይጠሩ ወደ ንጉሡ መግባት ግን ሞትን ሊያስከትል ይችል ነበር።
አስቴር ሁሉም እንዲጾሙና እንዲጸልዩ ጠየቀች። ከዚያም በድፍረት ወደ ንጉሡ ገባች። ንጉሡም የወርቅ በትሩን ዘርግቶ ተቀበላት።
አስቴር የሐማን ክፉ ሴራ ለንጉሡ ነገረችው። ንጉሡም አስቆመው፤ በአስቴር ድፍረትም የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ዳኑ።
lesson_en: God can use you to help others. Pray and be brave!
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ሌሎችን ለመርዳት ሊጠቀምብህ ይችላል። ጸልይ፤ ደፋርም ሁን!

quiz.q_en: What did Esther do before going to the king?
quiz.q_am: አስቴር ወደ ንጉሡ ከመግባቷ በፊት ምን አደረገች?

prayer_en: God, use me to help others and make me brave. Amen.
prayer_am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ሌሎችን ለመርዳት ተጠቀምብኝ፤ ደፋርም አድርገኝ። አሜን።

en: An angel visited a young woman named Mary and said, “You will have a baby, and you will call Him Jesus. He will be the Son of God!”
Mary and Joseph travelled to Bethlehem. The town was so full that there was no room for them, so they stayed where the animals slept.
That night baby Jesus was born. Mary wrapped Him in cloths and laid Him in a manger.
In the fields, angels appeared to shepherds singing, “Glory to God! A Saviour is born for you!” The shepherds hurried to see Jesus and told everyone the good news.
am: መልአክ ማርያም ወደምትባል ወጣት ሴት መጥቶ «ወንድ ልጅ ትወልጃለሽ፤ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ ትዪዋለሽ። እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ይባላል!» አላት።
ማርያምና ዮሴፍ ወደ ቤተ ልሔም ሄዱ። ከተማዋ እጅግ ስለ ተጨናነቀች ማረፊያ አላገኙም፤ ስለዚህ እንስሳት በሚያድሩበት ስፍራ አደሩ።
በዚያች ሌሊት ሕፃኑ ኢየሱስ ተወለደ። ማርያምም በጨርቅ ጠቅልላ በግርግም አስተኛችው።
በሜዳ ላይ ለነበሩ እረኞች መላእክት ተገለጡና «ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር! መድኃኒት ተወልዶላችኋል!» እያሉ ዘመሩ። እረኞቹም ኢየሱስን ለማየት ፈጥነው ሄዱ፤ የምሥራቹንም ለሁሉ ነገሩ።
lesson_en: Jesus is God’s greatest gift to the world.
lesson_am: ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔር ለዓለም የሰጠው ታላቁ ስጦታ ነው።

quiz.q_en: Where was Jesus born?
Who heard the angels sing?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, for sending Jesus to be my Saviour. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስን መድኃኒቴ እንዲሆን ስለ ላክኸው አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: When Jesus was twelve years old, His family went to Jerusalem for the Passover feast. Afterwards they started home with many friends.
Mary and Joseph thought Jesus was with the group, but He wasn’t! They searched for three days.
At last they found Him in the temple, sitting with the teachers, listening and asking questions. Everyone was amazed at His wisdom.
“Didn’t you know I must be in My Father’s house?” Jesus said. Then He went home and obeyed His parents, growing in wisdom and in favour with God and people.
am: ኢየሱስ የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ በነበረ ጊዜ ቤተሰቡ ለፋሲካ በዓል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ። ከዚያም ከብዙ ወዳጆቻቸው ጋር ወደ ቤታቸው ተመለሱ።
ማርያምና ዮሴፍ ኢየሱስ ከመንገደኞቹ ጋር ያለ መሰላቸው፤ ግን አልነበረም! ሦስት ቀን ፈለጉት።
በመጨረሻ በቤተ መቅደስ ከመምህራን ጋር ተቀምጦ ሲሰማቸውና ሲጠይቃቸው አገኙት። ሁሉም በጥበቡ ተደነቁ።
ኢየሱስም «በአባቴ ቤት እሆን ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ አታውቁምን?» አላቸው። ከዚያም ከእነርሱ ጋር ወደ ቤት ሄዶ ይታዘዛቸው ነበር፤ በጥበብና በቁመት፣ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት በሞገስ አደገ።
lesson_en: We can learn about God at any age, and we should obey our parents.
lesson_am: በማንኛውም ዕድሜ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መማር እንችላለን፤ ወላጆቻችንንም መታዘዝ አለብን።

quiz.q_en: How old was Jesus?

prayer_en: Jesus, help me grow in wisdom and obey my parents. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ በጥበብ እንዳድግና ወላጆቼን እንድታዘዝ እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: Peter and his friends had fished all night but caught nothing. Jesus got into Peter’s boat and said, “Go out into deep water and let down your nets.”
Peter said, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing — but because You say so, I will.”
Suddenly the nets were so full of fish that they began to break! They needed another boat to help, and both boats nearly sank.
Jesus said, “Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of people.” Peter, James and John left everything and followed Jesus.
am: ጴጥሮስና ጓደኞቹ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ቢያጠምዱም ምንም አላገኙም። ኢየሱስም ወደ ጴጥሮስ ታንኳ ገብቶ «ወደ ጥልቁ ፈቀቅ በልና መረባችሁን ጣሉ» አለው።
ጴጥሮስም «መምህር ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ደክመን ምንም አልያዝንም፤ ነገር ግን በቃልህ መረቡን እጥላለሁ» አለ።
ወዲያውም መረቦቹ እስኪቀደዱ ድረስ ብዙ ዓሣ ያዙ! ሌላ ታንኳ እንዲረዳቸው ጠሩ፤ ሁለቱም ታንኳዎች ሊሰጥሙ ደረሱ።
ኢየሱስም «ተከተሉኝ፤ ሰዎችን አጥማጆች አደርጋችኋለሁ» አላቸው። ጴጥሮስ፣ ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ሁሉን ትተው ኢየሱስን ተከተሉት።
lesson_en: When we listen to Jesus and follow Him, amazing things happen.
lesson_am: ኢየሱስን ስንሰማውና ስንከተለው አስደናቂ ነገሮች ይሆናሉ።

quiz.q_en: What happened when they let down the nets?

prayer_en: Jesus, I want to follow You every day. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ በየቀኑ ልከተልህ እፈልጋለሁ። አሜን።

en: One evening Jesus and His disciples got into a boat to cross the lake. Jesus was tired and fell asleep on a cushion.
Suddenly a terrible storm came. Huge waves crashed over the boat, and it began to fill with water. The disciples were terrified!
They woke Jesus: “Teacher, don’t You care that we are drowning?” Jesus stood up and said to the wind and waves, “Quiet! Be still!” — and everything became calm.
The disciples were amazed. “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey Him!”
am: አንድ ምሽት ኢየሱስና ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ባሕሩን ለመሻገር በታንኳ ተሳፈሩ። ኢየሱስ ደክሞ ስለ ነበር በትራስ ላይ ተኛ።
ድንገት ታላቅ ማዕበል ተነሣ። ትልልቅ ሞገዶች በታንኳው ላይ ተላተሙ፤ ታንኳውም በውኃ ይሞላ ጀመር። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እጅግ ፈሩ!
ኢየሱስንም ቀስቅሰው «መምህር ሆይ፥ ስንጠፋ አይገድህምን?» አሉት። ኢየሱስም ተነሥቶ ነፋሱንና ባሕሩን «ዝም በል፤ ጸጥ በል!» አለ፤ ሁሉም ጸጥ አለ።
ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተደነቁ፤ «ነፋስም ባሕርም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው?» አሉ።
lesson_en: Jesus is with us in every storm, and He is in control.
lesson_am: ኢየሱስ በማንኛውም ማዕበል ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ ሁሉም በእጁ ነው።

quiz.q_en: What was Jesus doing when the storm came?
quiz.q_am: ማዕበሉ ሲነሣ ኢየሱስ ምን ያደርግ ነበር?

prayer_en: Jesus, when I am afraid, I will trust You. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ በምፈራበት ጊዜ በአንተ እታመናለሁ። አሜን።

en: A huge crowd — more than five thousand people — followed Jesus to hear Him teach. It was getting late, and everyone was hungry.
Andrew found a boy who had five small loaves of bread and two little fish. “But what is that among so many?” he said.
Jesus took the boy’s lunch, thanked God for it, and began to share it. Everyone ate as much as they wanted!
Afterwards the disciples collected twelve baskets of leftovers. Jesus did a miracle with one boy’s small gift.
am: ከአምስት ሺህ በላይ የሚሆን ታላቅ ሕዝብ ትምህርቱን ለመስማት ኢየሱስን ተከተሉት። ቀኑ እየመሸ ነበር፤ ሁሉም ተርበው ነበር።
እንድርያስ አምስት የገብስ እንጀራና ሁለት ትንንሽ ዓሣ የያዘ ልጅ አገኘ። «ነገር ግን ይህ ለዚህ ሁሉ ሕዝብ ምን ይሆናል?» አለ።
ኢየሱስም የልጁን ምሳ ተቀብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ፤ ማካፈልም ጀመረ። ሁሉም የሚፈልጉትን ያህል በሉ!
ከዚያም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ የተረፈውን አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሰበሰቡ። ኢየሱስ በአንድ ልጅ ትንሽ ስጦታ ተአምር አደረገ።
lesson_en: Give what you have to Jesus — He can do great things with it.
lesson_am: ያለህን ለኢየሱስ ስጥ — በእርሱ ታላቅ ነገር ማድረግ ይችላል።

quiz.q_en: How many loaves did the boy have?
How many baskets were left over?

prayer_en: Jesus, I give You all I have. Use it for Your glory. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ያለኝን ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ ለክብርህ ተጠቀምበት። አሜን።

en: A man asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbour?” Jesus told a story. A man was travelling when robbers attacked him, took everything and left him hurt by the road.
A priest came by, saw him, and passed by on the other side. Then a temple helper came, looked, and also walked away.
Then a Samaritan — someone from a group that did not get along with the hurt man’s people — saw him and felt sorry for him. He bandaged his wounds, took him to an inn and paid for his care.
Jesus asked, “Which one was a neighbour?” “The one who showed mercy.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same.”
am: አንድ ሰው ኢየሱስን «ባልንጀራዬ ማን ነው?» ብሎ ጠየቀው። ኢየሱስም ምሳሌ ነገረው፦ አንድ ሰው መንገድ ሲሄድ ወንበዴዎች አግኝተው ያለውን ሁሉ ወስደው ቈስሎ በመንገድ ዳር ጣሉት።
አንድ ካህን በዚያ ሲያልፍ አይቶት ገለል ብሎ ሄደ። ከዚያም አንድ ሌዋዊ መጥቶ አየውና እርሱም አልፎ ሄደ።
ከዚያም አንድ ሳምራዊ — ከቈሰለው ሰው ሕዝብ ጋር የማይስማማ ወገን የሆነ — አይቶት አዘነለት። ቍስሉን አሰረለት፤ ወደ እንግዶች ማደሪያ ወስዶ እንዲጠብቁት ከፈለ።
ኢየሱስም «ከእነዚህ ባልንጀራ የሆነው የትኛው ነው?» አለ። «ምሕረት ያደረገለት» አለው። ኢየሱስም «ሂድ፤ አንተም እንዲሁ አድርግ» አለው።
lesson_en: Everyone is our neighbour. Show kindness to all people.
lesson_am: ሰው ሁሉ ባልንጀራችን ነው። ለሁሉ ደግነትን አሳይ።

quiz.q_en: Who helped the hurt man?

prayer_en: Lord, help me be kind to everyone I meet. Amen.
prayer_am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ለማገኛቸው ሁሉ ደግ እንድሆን እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: Jesus told a story about a father with two sons. The younger son said, “Give me my share of your money now!” He went far away and wasted it all.
Soon he had no money and no friends. He took a job feeding pigs and was so hungry he wanted to eat the pigs’ food.
He thought, “I will go home and say, ‘Father, I have sinned. I am not worthy to be your son.’” So he started home.
While he was still far away, his father saw him, ran to him, hugged him and kissed him. “My son was lost and is found!” The father threw a big party. God loves us like that father.
am: ኢየሱስ ሁለት ልጆች ስለ ነበሩት አባት ምሳሌ ተናገረ። ታናሹ ልጅ «የሚደርሰኝን ገንዘብ አሁን ስጠኝ!» አለ። ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄዶ ሁሉንም አባከነው።
ብዙም ሳይቆይ ገንዘብም ወዳጅም አጣ። እሪያዎችን የማሰማራት ሥራ ያዘ፤ እጅግ ከመራቡ የተነሣ የእሪያዎቹን ምግብ ሊበላ ይመኝ ነበር።
«ወደ አባቴ ቤት ሄጄ ‘አባቴ ሆይ፥ በድያለሁ፤ ልጅህ ልባል አይገባኝም’ እለዋለሁ» ብሎ አሰበ። ወደ ቤቱም ተነሣ።
ገና ሩቅ ሳለ አባቱ አየው፤ ሮጦ አቅፎ ሳመው። «ይህ ልጄ ጠፍቶ ነበር፤ ተገኘም!» አለ። አባትየውም ታላቅ ግብዣ አደረገ። እግዚአብሔርም እንደዚህ አባት ይወደናል።
lesson_en: No matter what we do, God welcomes us back with open arms when we turn to Him.
lesson_am: ምንም ብናደርግ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ስንመለስ በፍቅር ይቀበለናል።

quiz.q_en: What did the father do when he saw his son?

prayer_en: Father God, thank You for always loving me and welcoming me. Amen.
prayer_am: አባት እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለምትወደኝና ስለምትቀበለኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: Zacchaeus was a tax collector who had cheated many people. When Jesus came to his town, Zacchaeus wanted to see Him — but he was too short to see over the crowd.
So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree! When Jesus reached the spot, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, come down! I must stay at your house today.”
Zacchaeus hurried down, full of joy. People grumbled, “Jesus is visiting a sinner!”
But Zacchaeus’s heart changed. “I will give half of what I own to the poor, and pay back four times what I cheated!” Jesus said, “Today salvation has come to this house.”
am: ዘኬዎስ ብዙ ሰዎችን ያታለለ ቀረጥ ሰብሳቢ ነበር። ኢየሱስ ወደ ከተማው ሲመጣ ሊያየው ፈለገ — ነገር ግን ቁመቱ አጭር ስለ ነበር ከሕዝቡ በላይ ማየት አልቻለም።
ስለዚህ ወደ ፊት ሮጦ በሾላ ዛፍ ላይ ወጣ! ኢየሱስም ወደዚያ ስፍራ በደረሰ ጊዜ ቀና ብሎ «ዘኬዎስ ሆይ፥ ፈጥነህ ውረድ፤ ዛሬ በቤትህ እውል ዘንድ ይገባኛል» አለው።
ዘኬዎስም ደስ ብሎት ፈጥኖ ወረደ። ሰዎቹ ግን «ከኃጢአተኛ ሰው ቤት ሊያድር ገባ» ብለው አጉረመረሙ።
የዘኬዎስ ልብ ግን ተለወጠ። «ካለኝ እኩሌታውን ለድሆች እሰጣለሁ፤ የበደልኩትንም አራት እጥፍ እመልሳለሁ!» አለ። ኢየሱስም «ዛሬ ለዚህ ቤት መዳን ሆነለት» አለ።
lesson_en: Jesus loves everyone and can change our hearts.
lesson_am: ኢየሱስ ሁሉንም ይወዳል፤ ልባችንንም ሊለውጥ ይችላል።

quiz.q_en: Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree?

prayer_en: Jesus, come into my heart and change me. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ልቤ ግባና ለውጠኝ። አሜን።

en: Parents brought their little children to Jesus so He could bless them. But the disciples said, “Go away! Jesus is too busy.”
When Jesus saw this, He was not happy with the disciples. He said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not stop them!”
“The kingdom of God belongs to people like these children,” Jesus said. “Anyone who wants to come into God’s kingdom must trust like a child.”
Then Jesus took the children in His arms, put His hands on them and blessed them. Jesus loves you too!
am: ወላጆች እንዲባርካቸው ሕፃናት ልጆቻቸውን ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን «ሂዱ! ኢየሱስ ሥራ በዝቶበታል» አሏቸው።
ኢየሱስ ይህን ባየ ጊዜ በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተቈጣ። «ሕፃናትን ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው፤ አትከልክሉአቸውም» አለ።
«የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደነዚህ ላሉት ናትና» አለ። «የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም።»
ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ሕፃናቱን አቅፎ እጁን ጭኖ ባረካቸው። ኢየሱስ አንተንም ይወድሃል!
lesson_en: You are never too small for Jesus. He loves you!
lesson_am: ለኢየሱስ በጣም ትንሽ አይደለህም። ይወድሃል!

quiz.q_en: What did Jesus say about the children?

prayer_en: Thank You, Jesus, for loving me just as I am. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ እንዳለሁ ስለምትወደኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: Jesus loved people so much that He chose to die on a cross to take away our sins. His friends were very sad when He was buried in a tomb, and a big stone was rolled in front of it.
Early on Sunday morning, some women went to the tomb. The stone was rolled away and the tomb was empty!
Two angels in shining clothes said, “Why are you looking for the living among the dead? He is not here — He is risen!”
Jesus was alive! He appeared to His friends many times. Because Jesus rose again, everyone who believes in Him can have life forever with God.
am: ኢየሱስ ሰዎችን እጅግ ስለ ወደደ ኃጢአታችንን ለማስወገድ በመስቀል ላይ ሊሞት ወደደ። በመቃብር በተቀበረና ታላቅ ድንጋይ በመቃብሩ ደጅ በተገጠመ ጊዜ ወዳጆቹ እጅግ አዘኑ።
በእሑድ ማልዶ አንዳንድ ሴቶች ወደ መቃብሩ ሄዱ። ድንጋዩ ተንከባሎ ነበር፤ መቃብሩም ባዶ ነበረ!
የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ የለበሱ ሁለት መላእክት «ሕያውን ከሙታን መካከል ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? በዚህ የለም፤ ተነሥቶአል!» አሏቸው።
ኢየሱስ ሕያው ነበረ! ለወዳጆቹ ብዙ ጊዜ ተገለጠላቸው። ኢየሱስ ከሙታን ስለ ተነሣ በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር የዘላለም ሕይወት ይኖረዋል።
lesson_en: Jesus died for us and rose again. He is alive today!
lesson_am: ኢየሱስ ስለ እኛ ሞተ፤ ከሙታንም ተነሣ። ዛሬም ሕያው ነው!

quiz.q_en: What did the women find at the tomb?
On which day did Jesus rise?

prayer_en: Thank You, Jesus, for dying for me and rising again. Amen.
prayer_am: ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ስለ እኔ ስለ ሞትክና ስለ ተነሣህ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።

en: Before Jesus went back to heaven, He told His friends, “Wait in Jerusalem. I will send you the Holy Spirit to give you power.”
On the day of Pentecost the believers were praying together. Suddenly there was a sound like a mighty rushing wind, and something like flames of fire rested on each of them.
They were filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in other languages! Visitors from many countries heard about God in their own language.
Peter stood up and told everyone about Jesus. About three thousand people believed and were baptised that day. The church was born!
am: ኢየሱስ ወደ ሰማይ ከመመለሱ በፊት ወዳጆቹን «በኢየሩሳሌም ቈዩ፤ ኃይል እንዲሰጣችሁ መንፈስ ቅዱስን እልክላችኋለሁ» አላቸው።
በበዓለ ሃምሳ ቀን አማኞች በአንድነት ይጸልዩ ነበር። ድንገትም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ያለ ድምፅ ሆነ፤ እንደ እሳት ያሉ ልሳኖችም በእያንዳንዳቸው ላይ ተቀመጡ።
በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተሞሉ፤ በሌሎች ቋንቋዎችም ይናገሩ ጀመር! ከብዙ አገሮች የመጡ እንግዶችም ስለ እግዚአብሔር በገዛ ቋንቋቸው ሰሙ።
ጴጥሮስም ቆሞ ለሁሉም ስለ ኢየሱስ ነገራቸው። በዚያ ቀን ሦስት ሺህ የሚያህሉ ሰዎች አምነው ተጠመቁ። ቤተ ክርስቲያን ተወለደች!
lesson_en: God gives His Holy Spirit to help us live for Him and tell others about Jesus.
lesson_am: እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ እንድንኖርና ስለ ኢየሱስ ለሌሎች እንድንናገር መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይሰጠናል።

quiz.q_en: What did the sound from heaven sound like?
quiz.q_am: ከሰማይ የመጣው ድምፅ ምን ይመስል ነበር?

prayer_en: Holy Spirit, fill me and help me tell others about Jesus. Amen.
prayer_am: መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሆይ፥ ሙላኝ፤ ስለ ኢየሱስ ለሌሎች እንድናገር እርዳኝ። አሜን።

en: An important Ethiopian official, the treasurer of Queen Candace, was riding home in his chariot from Jerusalem. He was reading from the book of the prophet Isaiah.
An angel told Philip to go to that desert road. The Holy Spirit said, “Go to that chariot.” Philip ran up and asked, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
“How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” said the official. Philip sat with him and told him the good news about Jesus, the Lamb of God.
When they came to some water, the Ethiopian said, “Look, here is water! Why shouldn’t I be baptised?” Philip baptised him, and he went home to Ethiopia rejoicing!
am: የኢትዮጵያ ንግሥት የህንደኬ ገንዘብ ሁሉ አዛዥ የሆነ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጃንደረባ ከኢየሩሳሌም በሰረገላው ወደ አገሩ ይመለስ ነበር። የነቢዩን የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍም ያነብ ነበር።
መልአክ ፊልጶስን ወደዚያ የምድረ በዳ መንገድ እንዲሄድ ነገረው። መንፈስ ቅዱስም «ወደዚህ ሰረገላ ቅረብ» አለው። ፊልጶስም ሮጦ «የምታነበውን ታስተውለዋለህን?» አለው።
ጃንደረባውም «የሚመራኝ ሳይኖር ይህ እንዴት ይቻለኛል?» አለ። ፊልጶስም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀምጦ ስለ ኢየሱስ — ስለ እግዚአብሔር በግ — ወንጌልን ሰበከለት።
ውኃ ወዳለበት ስፍራ ሲደርሱ ጃንደረባው «እነሆ ውኃ፤ እንዳልጠመቅ የሚከለክለኝ ምንድር ነው?» አለ። ፊልጶስም አጠመቀው፤ እርሱም ደስ እያለው ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ተመለሰ!
lesson_en: God’s good news is for every nation — including Ethiopia! ‘Ethiopia shall stretch out her hands to God.’
lesson_am: የእግዚአብሔር የምሥራች ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ነው — ለኢትዮጵያም! «ኢትዮጵያ እጆችዋን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትዘረጋለች።»

quiz.q_en: Which book was the Ethiopian reading?
What happened when they found water?

prayer_en: Thank You, God, that Your love is for Ethiopia and for all the world. Amen.
prayer_am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ፍቅርህ ለኢትዮጵያና ለዓለም ሁሉ ስለ ሆነ አመሰግንሃለሁ። አሜን።
